LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Enlist_Letter_Label: Your colony now stands with the Thieves Guild. Open the guild ledger at any settlement hosting them to draw pay, take work and see your standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Enlist_Button_Desc: Get word to the Thieves Guild. No one will ever admit they asked you to join.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Enlist_Requrements_Not: The Thieves Guild does not trust you yet. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Fa: You cannot join the Thieves Guild while your colony is at odds with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Missions_Desc: See what work the guild has posted.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Menu_Missions_Desc: Open contracts posted by the Thieves Guild. Accepting one costs nothing; payment comes when it is done.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Salary_Desc: Collect your share from the guild's steward.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Provisions_Desc: Take what the guild sets aside for its members on the road.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the guild's keeping and collect them from any hall.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Thieves Guild? Your standing will suffer for it.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Resign_Letter_Label: Your colony has left the Thieves Guild. Its doors are closed to you for now.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Resign_Button_Desc: Give up your membership and every rank that goes with it.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Kick_Out_Label_Title: Relations have fallen too far. The Thieves Guild has struck your colony from its books.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Work_0_Desc: Quietly move goods that are better off out of town.
LanguageData.ESCP_ThievesGuild_Work_1_Desc: Study marks, routes and the art of talking your way out.
